reason: The original rank audit compared C0 metrics computed from float32 model probabilities with C1/C2 metrics computed from float64 transformed-logit probabilities. Distinct source logits occasionally tied after float32 sigmoid conversion, so AUROC/AUPRC differed despite monotone logit transforms.
scope: Only the rank-invariance audit changes. C0/C1/C2 scientific definitions, hard-decision probabilities, VLOO selection, candidate rule, development gates and outer-test policy are unchanged.
pre_amendment_inspection: The source-reproduction aggregate and original rank-audit aggregate were inspected. No private C1/C2 development performance was inspected for model selection before this amendment was frozen.

new_rank_audit.cases: 5 folds x 30 epochs x 13 validation patients = 1950 for each transformed coordinate
new_rank_audit.pairwise_order: For every pair of valid channels, sign(r0[j]-r0[k]) must equal sign(r1[j]-r1[k]) and sign(r2[j]-r2[k]); exact source-logit ties must remain ties.
new_rank_audit.stable_sort: Use a deterministic stable descending sort and require identical ordered channel indices (including source ties, whose original index order is preserved).
new_rank_audit.metrics: Compute EZ-AUPRC, EZ-AUROC, EZ-MRR, and Top1-is-EZ from the same float64 canonical EZ rank scores and labels for C0/C1/C2.
new_rank_audit.float32_probability_tie_count: Diagnostic only; must not fail the V2 audit.

unchanged_scientific_settings.source: 150 original frozen A1 checkpoints and canonical validation patients; no retraining
unchanged_scientific_settings.C0: Original frozen A1 NEZ probability for hard decisions
unchanged_scientific_settings.VLOO: Other 12 patients choose epoch/threshold; excluded patient is evaluated using the original tie-break rule
unchanged_scientific_settings.outer_test: Inaccessible in this experiment, including after a passing development gate; freeze manifest only
